Title: How do I block my credit card if it is lost or stolen?
Content:
If your credit card is lost or stolen, you should block it immediately to prevent misuse.
You can block your card via:
- The mobile banking app under "Cards" > "Block card"
- Online banking by going to “Card services”
- Our 24/7 emergency hotline at +45 70 20 70 20

After blocking the card, you can order a replacement directly through the app or receive guidance from customer support.

Title: What is the maximum amount I can transfer via mobile banking?
Content:
You can transfer up to DKK 500,000 per day through the mobile banking app.
For larger amounts, please use the desktop version of online banking, where the limit is DKK 1,000,000 per day.

If you need to transfer more than this, contact your advisor or the customer service hotline.

Title: How do I open a savings account?
Content:
To open a savings account, log in to your online or mobile banking and navigate to "Accounts" > "Open new account."
You can choose between:
- Standard Savings Account
- High-Interest Savings (requires minimum balance of DKK 25,000)

It typically takes 1–2 business days for the account to be active.

Title: How do I update my address or contact information?
Content:
You can update your address, phone number, or email directly through:
- Mobile banking app under "Profile" > "Personal details"
- Online banking under “Settings”

Changes are typically updated immediately. For legal address changes, we automatically sync with the national registry.

Title: How do I apply for a mortgage loan?
Content:
To apply for a mortgage:
1. Log in to online banking and choose “Loans” > “Apply for mortgage”
2. Fill out the digital application form with your income and property details
3. Upload necessary documents (salary slips, purchase agreement, etc.)

You will be contacted by a mortgage advisor within 2–3 business days.

Title: Can I get a loan pre-approval before buying a home?
Content:
Yes, we offer mortgage pre-approval so you know your buying range in advance.
Apply through online banking or contact your advisor. You will need to provide documentation of your income, expenses, and any existing loans.

Pre-approvals are typically valid for 3 months.

Title: What should I do if I forgot my online banking password?
Content:
If you've forgotten your password, you can reset it via the login screen by selecting “Forgot password.”
You’ll be guided to authenticate with your NemID or MitID.
If you’re unable to reset online, call our support center at +45 70 13 00 00 for assistance.

Title: How do I receive international transfers?
Content:
To receive international transfers, provide the sender with:
- Your full name and address
- Your IBAN (can be found under “Account details” in mobile banking)
- The bank's SWIFT/BIC code: DABADKKK

Transfers typically take 1–3 business days depending on the sending country.

Title: How can I change the limit on my credit card?
Content:
To request a change in your credit card limit:
- Go to “Cards” > “Card settings” > “Limit settings” in mobile or online banking
- Choose your new desired limit
- Confirm using MitID

Approval is typically instant but may take up to 24 hours.

Title: What fees apply for using my card abroad?
Content:
When using your card abroad:
- Currency exchange fee: 1.5% of the transaction amount
- ATM withdrawals: Up to DKK 30 per withdrawal depending on card type

Use the mobile app to see fee details for your specific card. You can also temporarily increase your card limit for travel.

Title: How do I activate my new debit card?
Content:
To activate your new debit card:
- Log in to the mobile banking app
- Go to “Cards” > “Activate card”
- Enter the last 4 digits of your card

You can also activate your card by making a purchase using your PIN.

Title: What is the difference between a fixed-rate and variable-rate loan?
Content:
- A fixed-rate loan locks your interest rate for the full term, providing stability in monthly payments
- A variable-rate loan can change over time, often starting with a lower rate but increasing based on market conditions

Discuss your risk tolerance with your advisor to choose the right loan type.

Title: Can I cancel a payment I’ve already made?
Content:
If the payment hasn’t been processed yet, you may cancel it via:
- “Payments” > “Pending transactions” in the app or online banking
If it’s already processed, contact the recipient directly or call support to request a reversal.

Title: How do I order a new MitID code app or card?
Content:
You can order a new MitID authenticator through:
- www.mitid.dk
- MitID app under “Manage devices”

You may need to verify your identity using your passport or NemID if it’s your first request.

Title: How do I add an authorized user to my account?
Content:
To authorize another person (e.g. spouse or accountant):
- Submit a power of attorney form online or at your local branch
- Verification of the other person's identity is required

Access can be limited to read-only or full transactional authority.

Title: What are the interest rates on personal loans?
Content:
Interest rates for personal loans depend on your credit profile, income, and loan amount.
Typical APRs range from 5.5% to 14.9%.
Use our loan calculator or speak to a loan advisor to get a personalized rate.

Title: How do I receive e-Boks or digital mail notifications?
Content:
To enable notifications:
- Log in to e-Boks or the mobile banking app
- Navigate to “Settings” > “Notifications”
- Choose SMS, email, or push notification preferences

Ensure your contact info is up to date.

Title: What should I do if my mobile phone with the banking app is stolen?
Content:
Immediately call support to block mobile banking access.
You can also log in from another device and remove the lost phone under "Manage devices."

For extra security, reset your MitID credentials.

Title: How can I set up recurring payments or standing orders?
Content:
To create a standing order:
- Go to “Payments” > “Recurring” in the app or online
- Enter the recipient, amount, frequency, and start date

You can pause or edit the order anytime.

Title: Can I open a youth or junior account for my child?
Content:
Yes. Children under 18 can have youth accounts with parental approval.
Open via online banking or at a branch. You’ll need to bring:
- Child’s CPR number and ID
- Parental ID

Youth accounts have no monthly fees and come with limited card access.

Title: What is two-factor authentication (2FA)?
Content:
2FA adds an extra layer of security by requiring:
1. Something you know (e.g., password)
2. Something you have (e.g., MitID app)

This helps protect your accounts even if your password is compromised.

Title: Can I use Apple Pay or Google Pay with my card?
Content:
Yes, our debit and credit cards support Apple Pay and Google Pay.
To activate:
- Open your wallet app
- Add your card manually or via mobile banking
- Authenticate with MitID

Digital wallets are accepted wherever contactless is enabled.

Title: What happens if my loan payment is delayed?
Content:
Missing a loan payment may result in:
- Late fees
- Impact on your credit score
- Default risk

If you're facing financial difficulties, contact us early to arrange a payment plan.

Title: How can I export my account statements?
Content:
In mobile or online banking, go to:
- “Accounts” > Select account > “Statements”
You can download in PDF or CSV format.
Statements are archived for up to 10 years.

Title: Can I access my accounts when traveling abroad?
Content:
Yes. You can access mobile and online banking from anywhere.
Ensure international roaming is enabled for SMS authentication.
For high-risk countries, temporary restrictions may apply—check our travel advisory.

Title: How do I report unauthorized transactions?
Content:
Report immediately via:
- Mobile banking: “Cards” > “Dispute transaction”
- Support hotline: +45 70 13 00 00

You may need to sign a dispute form. Most cases are resolved within 10 working days.

Title: How do I change my PIN code?
Content:
Use any ATM that supports PIN changes or go to:
- Mobile app: “Cards” > “PIN settings” > “Change PIN”

PIN changes are effective immediately.

Title: What is the processing time for international transfers?
Content:
Transfers to EU countries usually take 1–2 business days.
Transfers outside the EU may take 3–5 business days, depending on currency and recipient bank.

Title: Can I get a debit card without a credit feature?
Content:
Yes. Debit-only cards are available for customers who prefer not to have credit facilities.
These cards deduct funds directly from your current account and have daily limits.

Title: What is the difference between IBAN and SWIFT?
Content:
- IBAN identifies your specific account (used across Europe)
- SWIFT/BIC identifies the bank (used globally)

Both are needed for international transfers.
